model: 768-48-2 LIF, current encoding, Sheila hard negatives (fraction 0.3), input weights trained as 8-bit (QAT, w1 = c * 2^shift, stored as int16 Q10), seed 1 (best validation F1 of 3 seeds); firmware with the exact LIF threshold table (USE_LIF_TABLE). Chosen by the pre-registered rule of research/PLAN_SYNAPSE.md (S5); JOURNAL.md entry 14
previous_release: Sheila, 95 hidden neurons with hard negatives, plain 12-step LIF loop (JOURNAL.md entries 10-11), until 2026-10-17 (git commit f527f74), evidence in results/sheila_hardneg/; before that Sheila 64 hidden (git 3dbfdb6, results/sheila/) and "yes" (git 05ad009, results/)

board_tested.method: PYNQ Linux 3.0.1 over Ethernet (run_board.ps1, board_server.py, check_board.py)
board_tested.result: 40 verification vectors x3 bit-exact for keyword.bin (max 4,344,674 cycles, 43.45 ms) and keyword_kdot.bin (max 59,040 cycles, 0.59 ms); "2 of 3" stream patterns as specified (results/sheila_h48_b8/board_base.json, board_kdot.json)

firmware_build: research/tools/build_firmware.py research/results/S2/models/h48_b8_seed1.npz --out <dir> --images keyword_lut keyword_kdot_lut; keyword.bin = keyword_lut.bin (RV32IM), keyword_kdot.bin = keyword_kdot_lut.bin (kdot). Bitstreams unchanged.
